questions.prompt: If anyone seeks something true, let him question the wise philosophers.
questions.answer: Sī quis aliquid vērum quaerit, philosophōs sapientēs interroget.

questions.prompt: A certain horseman, wounded in the battle, gave something to the poor monk.
questions.answer: Eques quīdam, in proeliō vulnerātus, monachō pauperī aliquid dedit.

questions.prompt: Each of the horsemen was carrying a certain shield adorned with gold.
questions.answer: Quisque equitum clipeum quendam aurō ōrnātum portābat.

questions.prompt: I do not believe that anyone is able to conquer this savage enemy.
questions.answer: Nōn crēdō quemquam hunc hostem ferum vincere posse.

questions.prompt: Each of the citizens praised a certain leader with great zeal.
questions.answer: Cīvium quisque ducem quendam magnō studiō laudāvit.

questions.prompt: Does anyone dare to touch the sacred fire in the temple?
questions.answer: Num quisquam ignem sacrum in templō tangere audet?

questions.prompt: Some god, hidden by the clouds, was watching the trembling army.
questions.answer: Aliquī deus, nūbibus tēctus, exercitum trementem spectābat.

questions.prompt: You are able to choose any book you wish from the king's library.
questions.answer: Quemlibet librum ē rēgis bibliothēcā ēligere potes.

questions.prompt: A certain old woman was selling a certain fine fleece in the forum.
questions.answer: Anus quaedam vellus quoddam subtīle in forō vēndēbat.

questions.prompt: If any hope remains, we shall bravely defend the walls of the city.
questions.answer: Sī qua spēs manet, moenia urbis fortiter dēfendēmus.

questions.prompt: Each of the fishermen feared some unknown danger of the deep sea.
questions.answer: Piscātōrum quisque aliquod perīculum ignōtum altī maris timēbat.

questions.prompt: No one saw anything in the shadows of that dreadful night.
questions.answer: Nēmō quidquam in tenebrīs illīus noctis horrendae vīdit.

questions.prompt: Let each soldier defend his own standard with the greatest courage.
questions.answer: Suum quisque mīles signum maximā virtūte dēfendat.

questions.prompt: A certain messenger announced that something dreadful had happened in the mountains.
questions.answer: Nūntius quīdam aliquid horrendum in montibus accidisse nūntiāvit.

questions.prompt: The general gave a certain reward to each of the brave horsemen.
questions.answer: Imperātor equitum fortium cuique praemium quoddam dedit.

questions.prompt: A certain wise man used to teach that each thing has its own nature.
questions.answer: Sapiēns quīdam docēbat quamque rem suam nātūram habēre.

questions.prompt: If any enemy approaches the gates, sound the trumpets at once.
questions.answer: Sī quis hostis portīs appropinquat, statim tubās canite.

questions.prompt: The queen ordered each of the maidservants to bring some gift.
questions.answer: Rēgīna ancillārum quamque aliquod dōnum ferre iussit.

questions.prompt: A certain bard, deceived by false hope, ceased from his own toil.
questions.answer: Quīdam vātēs, spē falsā dēceptus, ā labōre suō dēstitit.

questions.prompt: If anyone should sail across the sea, let him fear no one.
questions.answer: Sī quis trāns mare nāviget, nēminem timeat.

questions.prompt: Each of the soldiers, wearied by sweat and toil, was seeking something to drink.
questions.answer: Quisque mīlitum, sūdōre et labōre fessus, aliquid bibere quaerēbat.

questions.prompt: A certain philosopher used to teach that anyone at all can attain wisdom.
questions.answer: Quīdam philosophus docēbat quemlibet sapientiam adipīscī posse.

questions.prompt: Without anyone's help, the Stoic bore his wounds with a calm mind.
questions.answer: Sine cūiusquam auxiliō, stoicus vulnera sua aequō animō tulit.

questions.prompt: Choose any book you wish, for each one contains something useful.
questions.answer: Ēlige quemvīs librum, nam quisque aliquid ūtile continet.

questions.prompt: Someone was carrying a certain letter to a certain general late at night.
questions.answer: Aliquis quandam epistulam ad quendam ducem sērā nocte ferēbat.

questions.prompt: A certain judge, moved by no fear, condemned each of the wicked men.
questions.answer: Iūdex quīdam, nūllō timōre mōtus, scelestōrum quemque damnāvit.

questions.prompt: If anyone should reveal the secret, a certain grave punishment awaits him.
questions.answer: Sī quis arcānum revēlet, poena quaedam gravis eum manet.

questions.prompt: Whoever seeks wisdom will find something useful in these books.
questions.answer: Quīcumque sapientiam petit, aliquid ūtile in hīs librīs inveniet.

questions.prompt: Each of the maidens brought a certain purple garment to the temple.
questions.answer: Virginum quaeque vestem quandam purpuream ad templum tulit.

questions.prompt: Nobody dared to say anything against the cruel tyrant.
questions.answer: Nēmō quidquam contrā tyrannum crūdēlem dīcere ausus est.

questions.prompt: A certain physician cured each of the wounded soldiers with a rare herb.
questions.answer: Medicus quīdam mīlitum sauciōrum quemque herbā rārā sānāvit.

questions.prompt: Choose any weapon you wish, for danger threatens on every side.
questions.answer: Tēlum quodvīs ēlige, nam perīculum undique imminet.

questions.prompt: If any hope of safety remains, we shall not abandon the walls.
questions.answer: Sī qua spēs salūtis manet, mūrōs nōn dēserēmus.

questions.prompt: Someone had hidden a certain letter beneath the marble threshold.
questions.answer: Aliquis epistulam quandam sub marmoreō līmine cēlāverat.

questions.prompt: Each thing has its own beauty, a certain philosopher taught.
questions.answer: Quaeque rēs suam pulchritūdinem habet, philosophus quīdam docuit.

questions.prompt: Whatever you promise, do not deceive anyone with empty words.
questions.answer: Quidquid pollicēris, nōlī quemquam inānibus verbīs dēcipere.

questions.prompt: A certain old man was offering something sweet to the weary travelers.
questions.answer: Senex quīdam dulce aliquid fessīs viātōribus offerēbat.

questions.prompt: Let each citizen guard his own home against any enemy whatever.
questions.answer: Cīvis quisque domum suam contrā quemvīs hostem tueātur.

questions.prompt: A certain maiden, adorned with flowers, was singing something joyful.
questions.answer: Virgō quaedam flōribus ōrnāta laetum aliquid canēbat.

questions.prompt: If anyone asks anything, answer with a calm mind.
questions.answer: Sī quis quid rogat, aequō animō respondē.

questions.prompt: A certain leader distributed some reward to each of the victors.
questions.answer: Dux quīdam victōrum cuique praemium aliquod distribuit.

questions.prompt: Whoever loves virtue fears no one in this life.
questions.answer: Quisquis virtūtem amat, nēminem in hāc vītā timet.

questions.prompt: A certain merchant was selling figs of every kind in the crowded forum.
questions.answer: Mercātor quīdam fīcōs omnis generis in forō frequentī vēndēbat.

questions.prompt: Some god, moved by pity, freed the captives from their chains.
questions.answer: Deus aliquī, misericordiā mōtus, captīvōs vinculīs līberāvit.

questions.prompt: Each of the boys carried a certain torch through the dark grove.
questions.answer: Puerōrum quisque facem quandam per obscūrum nemus portāvit.
